## Pick something you can do now

| Your starting point | Start here | Then try |
|---|---|---|
| New to statements | Lecture L2.1, then Activity 2.1 | Tutoring T1.1; home H2 |
| Know statements but mix up cash and profit | Reading R3.1–R3.7 | T2.1, T3.2, then H3 |
| Want double-entry practice | Main reference DEB example | T4.1, then H-DEB |
| Need cash-flow practice | Lecture L5.1 | Book 5.2, T4.2, then H5 |
| Need break-even practice | T5.1, T5.2 | T5.3, home H7, book 7.3 |
| Need scarce-resource practice | Activity 7.19 | Home H7(c), book 7.4, lecture L7.4 |
| Need full costing / ABC | Home H8, book 8.2 | Book 8.3, self-assessment 8.1, exercise 8.5 |
| Need investments | Lecture L10.1 | Book 10.1, self-assessment 10.1, lecture capstone L10.2 |

Use the chapter/source routes above to open these IDs. Attempt without help first; open the hint if stuck; compare reasoning only after you have written a solution. A correct number without an explanation or a failed reconciliation is a reason to retry.

> [!warning] Two outstanding sources
> The six required textbook **MC sets are absent** from the available PDF/archive. The Chapter 2 home sheet also requests **Exercise 2.6**, while this 12e book ends at 2.5. They remain visible gaps, not invented questions. Chapter 10 textbook practice is topic-aligned extra work, not a discovered Chapter 10 homework assignment.
